description: With the Goa’uld empire broken, Cameron Mitchell rebuilds SG-1 just as Daniel and Vala discover the Ori, ascended beings who demand worship and begin converting the Milky Way by force. The team searches Arthurian legends for a weapon capable of opposing an enemy far beyond conventional Goa’uld power.

s09e01.description: Cameron Mitchell arrives determined to reunite SG-1, while Daniel and Vala become trapped in an Ancient communication device linked to a distant galaxy.

s09e02.description: Daniel and Vala discover a human civilization ruled by the Ori as Mitchell’s search for the missing team leads into Arthurian legend.

s09e03.description: The Ori send a Prior to the Milky Way demanding worship, and SG-1 gets its first direct demonstration of the new enemy’s power.

s09e04.description: Vala’s criminal past catches up with her, forcing SG-1 through a chain of deals and old associates to break the device binding her to Daniel.

s09e05.description: Vala returns to a world where she once posed as a god, just as an Ori Prior arrives offering miracles and demanding a different form of submission.

s09e06.description: An Ori beachhead begins forming in the Milky Way, forcing SG-1, the Jaffa and the Goa’uld Ba’al into an unlikely effort to stop it.

s09e07.description: Ba’al is found living openly on Earth under a corporate identity, but capturing him becomes difficult when multiple clones enter the game.

s09e08.description: Mitchell is challenged by a warrior society while Daniel tries to understand a culture being drawn toward the Ori.

s09e09.description: SG-1 finds another genetically engineered Goa’uld-human hybrid whose powers and ambitions echo Anubis’s earlier experiments.

s09e10.description: An Ori plague reaches Earth while Gerak brings the Jaffa toward Origin, forcing old allies to choose between fear, faith and independence.

s09e11.description: The Ori plague spreads as Gerak’s conversion gives him the power of a Prior, leaving Earth’s survival dependent on whether he can still choose for himself.

s09e12.description: Mitchell awakens accused of murder on an alien world where memory-recording technology appears to prove he committed the crime.

s09e13.description: Multiple SG-1 teams from alternate realities arrive through the gate, turning a scientific anomaly into a crowded problem with one dangerously different group.

s09e14.description: Bra’tac and Teal’c investigate political manipulation inside the new Jaffa government while Landry confronts a painful connection to his past.

s09e15.description: SG-1 returns to a world caught between rival nations and the Ori, where an advanced weapon threatens to turn a fragile conflict into annihilation.

s09e16.description: Stargates begin disappearing across the galaxy, leading SG-1 to a Ba’al scheme and an unexpected confrontation aboard a stolen cargo ship.

s09e17.description: A diplomatic mission becomes a siege when voracious alien insects overrun a research facility and begin multiplying toward escape.

s09e18.description: Mitchell and Carter become trapped out of phase with normal reality while Teal’c investigates a Jaffa leader’s role in a growing political crisis.

s09e19.description: Vala uses the Ancient communication stones to warn SG-1 that the Ori are preparing a fleet and that she has become central to their plans.

s09e20.description: SG-1 searches Camelot for Merlin’s anti-Ori weapon as the first Ori warships enter the Milky Way and overwhelm a combined defensive fleet.
